Marten._comment: Configured but DISABLED (DEC-017). Enable in Sprint-5+ for event sourcing.

Database._seed_comment: FRESH-BUILD defaults (2026-07-23): all seeders OFF. The deploy starts with only DefaultCoASeed + DefaultInventorySeed as reference data. Owner registers the first real user via /api/auth/register. To re-enable seeders for a demo/staging environment, flip the flags here + revert the Program.cs seeder block.
Database._resiliency_comment: Npgsql Resiliency baseline (DEC-093, 2026-07-24): CommandTimeout 60s prevents OutboxProcessor timeouts on long queries; Keepalive 30s + Tcp Keepalive prevents stale connections across Supabase pooler; Pool sizing 1-20 fits the 6GB RAM local dev + HF Space free tier (2 vCPU 16GB).
Database._json_migration_comment: JsonMigrationEnabled=true (DEC-096, 2026-07-24): the JSON migrator (DataTypeMigrator) was OFF by default (Fresh Build Mode), but combined with NoOp C# migrations (DEC-080/082), this led to missing tables (accounts, vendor_bills, warehouses, etc.). Now enabled to ensure all JSON-defined tables are created on every startup. Idempotent (additive only).
